SCOPE: One never-started image assembly container plus one NEW disposable raw preparation container; pinned local image; no policy/source acceptance

create/start one isolated readonly preparation container
inspect own launch/birth/namespace and send one fixed private preparation stdin command
remove only label/ID-verified owned containers and their own anonymous volumes
PROHIBITED_EFFECTS: pull/push/network outside existing local Docker endpoint
host Docker socket/namespace/mount exposure to candidate
